AccuracySource.description: An accuracy metric of the readout's actuals (or its history over readouts).
AccuracySource.title: AccuracySource

ActualsInputs.description:
Uploads of new actuals. ``review``: an editor publishes each upload into the history;
``auto``: it goes straight in. ``allow_refit_requests`` lets the uploader ask for a refit
with ``refit_workflow_id`` (a workflow of the same project whose input node takes the
dashboard's dataset); an editor with runner rights approves it (§10.4).
ActualsInputs.title: ActualsInputs

ActualsInputsV2.description:
Actuals for any model type. ``match="time"``: per period, as layout 1;
``match="row"``: per case, joined on ``id_column`` (the outcome is ``label_column`` or
the target). ``threshold``: the probability above which a classifier says "positive"
(the analyst sets it; clients cannot change it).
ActualsInputsV2.title: ActualsInputsV2

BatchDef.description:
Batch scoring: a CSV of up to ``max_rows`` new cases (one ``id_column`` plus the
driver columns); with ``enforce_ranges`` every cell is checked like a scenario row.
BatchDef.title: BatchDef

ChannelDef.description: One media channel and the range its what-if slider covers (``1`` = the current plan).
ChannelDef.title: ChannelDef

ChartPanel.description: A native chart (``intent``) of an output or of the accuracy history.
ChartPanel.title: ChartPanel

DashboardSource.description:
The model a dashboard reads. ``model_version``: ``model_id`` (and ``version``; the
latest ready version when omitted) is pinned at publish. ``endpoint``: ``alias`` is
resolved to its current version and endpoint revision at publish.
DashboardSource.title: DashboardSource

DashboardSpec.description:
What a dashboard shows (the stored draft and each published revision).

``layout_version`` 1 is the fixed planner layout: up to :data:`MAX_TILES` KPI tiles, the
channel scorecard and the tabs (``this_period`` always first). Text fields are plain
text, rendered as text (never HTML or markdown). The serialised spec holds at most
:data:`MAX_SPEC_BYTES`; :func:`dashboard_spec_hash` is its identity.

examples.note: Results use the model fitted on data to 18/10/2026.
examples.summary: How media spend drives online orders, updated every Monday.
examples.title: Weekly media results

DashboardSpec.title: DashboardSpec

DashboardSpecV2.description:
What a layout 2 dashboard shows (the stored draft and each published revision).

``layout_version`` is required (never a default: the hash rule). Panels are at most
:data:`MAX_PANELS` (at most :data:`MAX_KPI_PANELS` KPI tiles) with unique ids, of the
kinds and intents the preset allows (:data:`PRESET_RULES`); ``mmm`` is given exactly for
the ``mmm_planner`` preset. Text fields are plain text. The serialised spec holds at most
:data:`~mapi_spec.dashboards.MAX_SPEC_BYTES`.

panels.text: The forecast starts from the newest month that you sent.
panels.title: About these numbers

examples.summary: The sales that we expect for the next months.
examples.title: Monthly sales forecast

DashboardSpecV2.title: DashboardSpecV2

DimBind.description: The input picks a coordinate of a dim (a store, a period).
DimBind.title: DimBind

HorizonDef.description: How many periods ahead a forecast scenario row reaches.
HorizonDef.title: HorizonDef

KpiDef.description:
The business result the dashboard reports (a model output variable).

``value_per_unit`` (currency per unit of a ``count`` KPI, e.g. the margin of one order)
gives a breakeven return, so the channel zones can be shown for count KPIs too.
KpiDef.title: KpiDef

KpiPanel.description:
A KPI tile. ``stat``: the centre or a bound of an output (``value`` for metrics,
checks and accuracy); ``band``: ``outcome`` (the range of one new result, scored as
predictive), ``mean`` (the range of the average) or ``none``; ``compare``: the change
against the previous published readout; ``good``: which direction is good news.
KpiPanel.title: KpiPanel

MetricSource.description:
A metric logged by the fit run (``labels`` pick one row, e.g. ``{"unit": "s1"}``;
the empty labels are the run's scalar value).
MetricSource.title: MetricSource

MmmPanel.description:
A part of the media planner (``mmm_planner`` preset only): the layout 1 tiles, the
channel scorecard, the changes against the expectation, the return trend or the saved
scenarios.
MmmPanel.title: MmmPanel

MmmPlanner.description:
The media planner part of the ``mmm_planner`` preset (layout 1's channels, what-ifs
and tiles).
MmmPlanner.title: MmmPlanner

NotePanel.description: Plain text from the analyst (rendered as text, never HTML or markdown).
NotePanel.title: NotePanel

OutputSource.description:
A model output (its score summary table; names as the dataset names them).
``select`` fixes coordinates (``{"store": "s1"}``) before any reduction.
OutputSource.title: OutputSource

RecipePanel.description:
A platform plot recipe: drawn natively when the recipe is in :data:`RECIPE_INTENTS`,
else a **picture** of the model version's plot ``plot_id`` (rendered once at publish).
RecipePanel.title: RecipePanel

Reduce.description:
How an output becomes the panel's numbers.

``select``: the cells of ``source.select``; ``last``/``next``: the last fitted or the
next forecast period; ``mean``/``sum`` over dims ``over`` (of draws only the ``sum``
over the time dim of a forecast: the forecast total, with its range; point outputs
are allowed and flagged ``approximate``); ``share_above``: the share of cells above
``threshold``; ``top_class``: the most probable class. The server never adds interval
bounds.
Reduce.title: Reduce

RefreshPolicy.description:
``workflow_id``: a successful run of this workflow (its ``model.score`` or
``model.forecast`` node) appends a refresh readout. ``follow_endpoint`` (endpoint
sources only): a promotion publishes a new revision on the new version.
RefreshPolicy.title: RefreshPolicy

ScenarioInputDef.description:
One value a client may edit in a scenario row (or a batch column, when ranges are
enforced). ``number``/``integer`` need ``min`` < ``max`` (and at most
:data:`MAX_SCENARIO_STEPS` steps); ``choice`` needs ``choices``; ``date`` needs
``date_min``/``date_max``. ``applies``: per row, or for the forecast horizon.
ScenarioInputDef.title: ScenarioInputDef

ScenarioRowsDef.description:
Scenario rows ("Try a case"): clients edit ``inputs`` (at most ``max_rows`` rows per
request); ``fixed`` values are sent with every row and never shown; the model scores
``outputs`` with their uncertainty.
ScenarioRowsDef.title: ScenarioRowsDef

ScorecardSource.description: One check of the model version's scorecard.
ScorecardSource.title: ScorecardSource

SubjectDef.description:
What the dashboard is about (the main output and how to show its numbers).

``positive_label`` is the class a classifier reports the chance of; ``value_per_unit``
(currency per unit of a count) is for the MMM planner only.
SubjectDef.title: SubjectDef

TablePanel.description: A table of an output (``columns``: dims and stats, in order).
TablePanel.title: TablePanel

VarBind.description: The input sets an input variable (a driver column).
VarBind.title: VarBind

ViewSource.description:
A guided view of the readout's run: the forecast total over the horizon, the
counterfactual delta, or the conditioning of a forecast on actuals.
ViewSource.title: ViewSource

WhatIfInputs.description: Scenario sliders (the response grid, free) and ``exact`` results (a score run).
WhatIfInputs.title: WhatIfInputs

description:
An immutable published revision: the spec (either layout) and the model version it
pins.

spec.note: Results use the model fitted on data to 18/10/2026.
spec.summary: How media spend drives online orders, updated every Monday.
spec.title: Weekly media results
